about.heading: About
about.paragraph: I design tailor-made websites created to highlight and enhance your business.

explore.heading: A few words about me
explore.paragraph:
Hi, I am Romain!

After ten years in watchmaking, where precision, rigor and attention to detail were part of my daily work, I decided to take on a new challenge: web development, a field I am passionate about for its varied tasks and endless possibilities.

My training and career change efforts became reality through Hakuna Mataweb. Today, I put my meticulous mindset and new skills at your service to showcase your business, whatever it may be.
